observations: Photo 0: white front-loading washing machine, LG logo top left of the control panel.
Photo 0: panel reads 'Inverter DirectDrive 7kg' with a small model code under it that looks like F10xx series but is too small to read with certainty.
Photo 0: rotary program dial (Cotton, Cotton Quick, Synthetic, Delicate, Baby Care, Hand Wash/Wool, Blanket, Quick 30, Rinse+Spin), small digital display, push buttons for Spin and Temp.
Photo 0: 'DD Motor 10 year warranty' sticker and 'Less Noise, Less Vibration, More Durability' sticker on the front.
Photo 0: rust along the top edge of the front panel under the control fascia, rust at the bottom edge above the kick plate, general yellowing and grime on the cabinet and door ring.
Photo 0: the machine sits unplugged on a bare concrete floor outdoors or in a yard, no power or running shown.
Photo 0: older generation LG styling, not consistent with a machine bought new last year.

identity.model: Inverter DirectDrive 7kg (model code partly legible, F10xx series)
read_from: photo 0 front control panel: LG logo
photo 0 front control panel: Inverter DirectDrive 7kg

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows LG logo and 'Inverter DirectDrive 7kg' on the panel.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows rust on the front panel top and bottom edges, yellowed cabinet and grime; this is an older model with years of use.
No clip of the machine filling, washing, spinning and draining; no power-on shown.
Motor sits behind the drum; tamper state cannot be confirmed from photos. Only an in-person check of the rear panel screws would help.
No photo of a receipt or warranty card; given the visible age, a receipt dated last year would itself need checking against the serial.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on, fill, wash, spin or drain (control board, pump or motor fault)
risks.proof: One continuous clip: plug in, power on, select a program, show water filling, drum turning, then a spin and drain

risks.risk: Rust may extend into the cabinet base, door hinge area or drum support, and the drum bearings may be worn
risks.proof: Clip spinning the empty drum by hand with the door open plus photos of the back, sides and underside

risks.risk: Door seal (gasket) may be torn or mouldy, causing leaks
risks.proof: Close photo of the door rubber pulled back all round
risks.if_unproven: as needing a new door seal

risks.risk: Exact model and age unknown; the rating plate would show model, serial and manufacture date
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rating plate on the back or inside the door rim
risks.if_unproven: as an old model of the LG DirectDrive 7kg line

risks.risk: Missing parts such as inlet and drain hoses or power cord damage
risks.proof: Photo of the back showing the power cord, inlet hose and drain hose

proof_requests: A continuous clip of the machine powered on, filling, washing and spinning, then draining
A clear photo of the rating plate showing model, serial and manufacture date
Photos of the back, sides and underside showing the extent of rust
A close photo of the door seal pulled back
Photo of the receipt and warranty card, if they exist
response.reason: Brand and range are readable on photo 0, so it can be priced as an older used LG DirectDrive 7kg front loader at its worst case, not working and with rust. The 'bought new last year' claim is contradicted by visible rust and wear, so it adds nothing to the price.
